headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while oil, rates and geopolitical risk sustain high Stress
body: NQ futures are closed for the weekend, so there is no live price path showing persistent mean-reversion failure. Friday finished with a higher Nasdaq after substantial two-way trading, while the 10-year Treasury yield stayed above 5% and crude settled above $100. These conditions keep Stress high, but they do not establish a pathological Tail path during closure.
